title: Roof Age at Renewal: LandlordGuard Underwriting Load
content:
**Guideline.** The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal carries a roof-age load that looks at the roof's age on the upcoming effective date, counted in whole months from January 1 of the roof install year. A roof more than 20 years old (more than 240 whole months) gives 12 percent; one more than 15 but not more than 20 years old (more than 180 and up to 240 whole months) gives 6 percent; one 15 years old or younger (180 whole months or fewer) gives 0 percent.

The roof-age load is a percentage added into the rating percentage by which the indicated renewal premium is increased after the inflation guard; that rating percentage is applied once.

The upcoming effective date is the first day of the renewal term, which is the expiration date of the term now in force. The roof install year is the one on the policy record.

| Whole months from January 1 of the roof install year to the upcoming effective date | Roof-age load |
|---|---|
| more than 240 | 12 percent |
| 181 to 240 | 6 percent |
| 180 or fewer | 0 percent |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical roofs)

| Roof install year | Upcoming effective date | Whole months | Load |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2005 | 15 January 2025 | 240 | 6 percent |
| 2005 | 1 February 2025 | 241 | 12 percent |
| 2010 | 20 January 2025 | 180 | 0 percent |
| 2010 | 1 February 2025 | 181 | 6 percent |
